name: Read All
description: Mark every server as read in one click, with a button above the server list, /readall, or the server right-click menu. DMs too if you want.

notes: Smoother: the unread count no longer holds up Discord while it starts, and counts a few servers at a time when the browser is idle.
Faster: the unread count waits for a quiet moment and skips servers with nothing unread, instead of recounting on every message.
